title: Affine locally free extension core
statement: theorem exists_affine_locally_free_model_core (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens) (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : ∃ H : (Spec A).Modules, H.IsQuasicoherent ∧ (∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V → Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) ∧ Nonempty (Modules.restrict H W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Spec A is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Noetherianity makes every open W compact. Transport P through the inverse of Modules.overEquiv W. Finite local freeness implies finite presentation. Reuse the proved private finitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse helper from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectNoetherianCohomology (the module of [lem-pc-perfect-noetherian-cohomology]), made available with a proof-only import all. Only this transport helper is used, not the perfect-complex cohomology theorem. The helper applies the existing finite-presentation pushforward theorem for a continuous, cocontinuous left adjoint and the inverse equivalence unit comparison.

Apply exists_finitePresentation_extension with ambient structure sheaf and the zero morphism, obtaining a finitely presented H and an isomorphism H.over W to the transported P. The ambient structure sheaf is quasicoherent by the existing isQuasicoherent_unit instance. H is quasicoherent because it is finitely presented.

For each affine open V, apply finitePresentation_sections_of_isFinitePresentation to H. The existing instance from module finite presentation to module finiteness gives the required affine-section finiteness.

Compose the inverse of overFunctorEquiv W at H, the image of the over-site extension isomorphism under overEquiv W, and the equivalence counit at P. This gives H.restrict W.ι isomorphic to P. Package H and the three assertions.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0G41(2), using the existing Tag 01PI extension theorem; affine-section finiteness from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent
